name: design-consistency
title_zh: 对着真实代码库查设计一致性，不看设计稿
tagline_zh: 别等用户截图吐槽「这按钮怎么两种圆角」。直接扫仓库，揪出重复组件、跑偏色值、失控字号。
tagline_en: Stop users screenshotting 'why two button radii?' Scan the repo for duplicated components, off-palette colors.
desc_en: In-app consistency audit run directly against the real codebase — not a separate design file. Flags duplicate or divergent component usage, inconsistent typography, off-palette color, and behavioral inconsistency in how forms validate, modals open, and errors are shown across flows. Use to check whether the shipped product is internally consistent with itself.
why_zh: 它把审计对象从 Figma 挪到真实 DOM——设计稿再干净，代码里长歪了才是真歪。
why_en: It audits the shipped DOM, not the Figma—because a clean spec means nothing if the code drifted. Catches behavioral splits.
limit_zh: 只认代码里能静态摸到的证据：组件树、样式表、事件绑定。运行时才出现的动态样式。
limit_en: Only static evidence: component trees, stylesheets, event bindings. Dynamic runtime styles, cross-iframe or shadow-DOM components are out—needs.
title_en: Audit design consistency in live code, not design files
